turns.prompt_text: on my MacBook Air, I have Karabiner installed. But if I don't have to use it, I'd prefer not to and just use the Mac system settings. Currently, I don't like the way the screenshot/screensnip key bindings are set up. Right now, if I press Shift-Control-Command-4 it will take a screen snip onto my clipboard. If I press Shift Command 4, it will take a screen snip into a folder. I would prefer to flip those two key bindings.
turns.response_html:
You can absolutely do this natively in macOS without needing to configure a new rule in Karabiner.

Because macOS prevents you from assigning a keyboard shortcut that is currently assigned to another active command, you will need to use a temporary "placeholder" shortcut for a few seconds to successfully swap them.

You're very welcome! I'm glad we could get that sorted out natively for you.

Let me know if you need help tweaking any other settings!
